items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And opposite us was Scatman Crothers and his band, and with his band he had one of the first bass players that was really playing in the bottom of the bass, a kid named Vic MacMillan he had brought out.

ctx.x: And we were getting prepared to go on our big job, and we had worked and made a little money. So we had bought uniforms, and we had our light tan trousers and our brown jackets and everything, with our little neckties -- and we were sharp! We were going into Billy Berg's Swing Club.

And opposite us was Scatman Crothers and his band, and with his band he had one of the first bass players that was really playing in the bottom of the bass, a kid named Vic MacMillan he had brought out. A fine bass player. He was on the first things that Charlie Parker did on his own in California, the thing with "Ornithology" and "Yardbird Suite" and those things -- and Roy Porter was on the same date. Anyway, he also had with him Benny Bailey, the great trumpet. Benny Bailey was with him; he had brought him out…
